mock_response.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud — Integration Guide
mock_response.content: SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition integrates with external systems via SAP Integration Suite. The recommended integration approach uses pre-built integration content from the SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Key integration scenarios include: (1) SAP Ariba to S/4HANA for purchase order and invoice flows, (2) SAP Analytics Cloud to S/4HANA for live financial reporting, (3) Salesforce CRM to S/4HANA for order-to-cash automation. All scenarios use event-driven or API-based patterns managed through SAP Integration Suite.
